comment: Optional changes to the 1.8.9 experience. Every addition is off in the Faithful look; Recommended turns on the ones marked recommended. The game reads this file, and so does the launcher (from the LegacyCraft folder). Game additions are saved per instance in additions.txt; launcher additions in launcher_profiles.json.

additions.name: Toggle Sprint
additions.description: Press Sprint once to keep sprinting, press it again to stop.

additions.name: Toggle Sneak
additions.description: Press Sneak once to keep sneaking, press it again to stand up.

additions.name: Full Bright
additions.description: Caves and nights are lit as if you had Night Vision.

additions.name: Coordinates
additions.description: Shows your position and the way you face in the top-left corner, without F3.

additions.name: FPS Counter
additions.description: Shows the frames per second in the top-right corner.

additions.name: No Damage Tilt
additions.description: The view no longer rolls when you get hurt.

additions.name: Steady Field of View
additions.description: Sprinting, flying and potions no longer widen or narrow the view.

additions.name: Solid Crosshair
additions.description: Draws the crosshair white with a dark outline, so it shows up on any background.

additions.name: Remember Tab
additions.description: The launcher opens on the tab you used last instead of News.

additions.name: What's New
additions.description: When an update brings new Additions, the launcher lists them when it starts.

additions.name: Look on Instances
additions.description: Each instance in the list shows its look (Faithful, Recommended or Custom).
